---
title: "Publications"
---

A full and up-to-date list is available on my
[Google Scholar profile](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=t-GO214AAAAJ&hl=fr).

<div id="pub-preprints"></div>
<div id="pub-articles"></div>
<div id="pub-proceedings"></div>

<script src="papers.js"></script>

<script>
function paperLink(paper) {
  if (paper.doi) {
    return `DOI: <a href="https://doi.org/${paper.doi}"><code>${paper.doi}</code></a>`;
  }

  if (paper.arxiv) {
    return `arXiv: <a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/${paper.arxiv}"><code>${paper.arxiv}</code></a>`;
  }

  return "";
}

function renderPublications(containerId, title, type) {
  const container = document.getElementById(containerId);

  const selected = papers
    .filter(paper => paper.type === type)
    .sort((a, b) => b.year - a.year);

  if (selected.length === 0) return;

  const section = document.createElement("section");
  section.className = "publication-section";

  const heading = document.createElement("h2");
  heading.textContent = title;
  section.appendChild(heading);

  const list = document.createElement("ul");
  list.className = "publication-list";

  selected.forEach(paper => {
    const item = document.createElement("li");
    item.className = "publication-item";

    const link = paperLink(paper);
    const authors = paper.citationAuthors || paper.authors.join(", ");

    item.innerHTML = `
      <span class="publication-authors">${authors}</span>,<br>
      <strong>${paper.title}</strong>,<br>
      <em>${paper.venue}</em>, ${paper.year}.
      ${link ? `<br>${link}` : ""}
      ${paper.note ? `<br><span class="publication-note">${paper.note}</span>` : ""}
    `;

    list.appendChild(item);
  });

  section.appendChild(list);
  container.appendChild(section);
}

renderPublications("pub-preprints", "Preprints", "preprint");
renderPublications("pub-articles", "Journal articles", "article");
renderPublications("pub-proceedings", "Conference proceedings", "proceeding");
</script>
